archive.summary: Payment method restrictions, scheduled bulk client-chat messages, and the redesigned CRM import all reached full release, Work Forecaster job-health indicators entered beta, and the Desktop app started warning about printer setup problems — alongside 8 bug fixes including Klarna/Affirm display issues and job date filters using the wrong timezone.

Automatic pricing-update emails rolled out for special-rate firms, jobs could be assigned by role instead of by name, drag-and-drop returned to the Desktop app's Upload Window, and Payment Method Restrictions entered beta — alongside 8 bug fixes including a 2FA login crash and payment methods getting wiped mid-billing.

Firms got the ability to charge clients' saved payment methods directly, plus beta features for scheduling bulk client-chat messages and smoother CRM imports, alongside 23 bug fixes including a Stripe reconciliation issue and documents stuck in "Sending."
